subject.why: The Jolly Roger flag is instantly recognisable, complete with its wooden pole and friendly skull and crossbones emblem.

category.why: The flag floats freely in the air with no ground or table, set against a radiating sunburst pattern as required for Category 1.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, watermarks, or extraneous characters.

framing.why: The flag is centrally positioned with comfortable margins on all sides and a chunky, readable silhouette.

colour.why: The background has bright, saturated warm yellow light rays that offer strong, clear contrast against the black flag.

detail.why: The shapes are bold and simplified without noisy micro-textures, scratches, or unrequested props.

style.why: Smooth 3D chunky volumes with soft satin sheen and clean bevels matching the game's reference style.

bg_colour.why: background is yellow (83% of the background); planned yellow
